<div class="card-body">
'''Yavin 4: Docking Bay''' is a [[Light]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ヤヴィン４：ドッキング・ベイ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">他のドッキング・ベイへ、フォース消費無しで移動できる。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここから、他のドッキング・ベイに移動するには、２フォース必要。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-136o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Yavin 4: Docking Bay.

'''Light Side:''' You may move to another docking bay without using Force.

'''Dark Side:''' Moving from here to another docking bay costs 2 Force.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese is moving to another docking bay; English is your docking bay transit.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Yavin 4: Docking Bay]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
